text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
—Narita Top Road has won! Cheers envelope 
the venue. In the next moment, words of 
heartfelt gratitude spilled from her lips.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having lived up to the expectations of her 
fans... and her Trainer, Narita Top Road 
was able to demonstrate hope for the 
future through her running.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That also served as a turning point for 
Admire Vega. Realizing that for "that 
girl's" sake, she needed to keep running 
toward the future.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Kikuka Sho drew to a bright close. 
Yet, that was only the beginning of Act 
Two— the Tenno Sho (Spring) was waiting 
for her.
